items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for searchwoot.com public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible internal work; counsel_required for rights-dependent public display, monetization, privacy jurisdiction, and notification decisions. Accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, security/release, and owner gates are also blocked. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown; analytics is yellow; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; security sitefacts remain unknown. Do not infer legal clearance, revenue, ROI, or causal lift. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence. Keep Woot permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable. Open tasks remain source rights, data-flow/retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling.
